title: FULL Guide to Becoming a Principled Agentic Engineer (Build Anything with AI)
summary: Cole Medin workshop: ideate with clarifying questions, PRD to tickets, PIV loop (plan/implement/validate) and system evolution.

assertions.quote: a lot of these frameworks are very over-engineered ... what I teach here is simple on purpose

verdicts.note: Owning and understanding your workflow helps you debug it, and many practitioners report framework bloat; but there is no comparative evidence, and frameworks can be a good starting point.

assertions.quote: the most powerful strategy here ... is to have the coding agent ask you questions

verdicts.note: Requirements clarification before implementation is well-established practice and widely reported to reduce agent rework.

assertions.quote: anytime you find yourself prompting something more than three times, you should turn it into a command or skill

verdicts.note: Reusable commands/skills reduce variance and share practice across a team; the 'three times' threshold is a rule of thumb.

assertions.quote: it's important for us to review the artifact and make sure that things are really aligned

verdicts.note: Reviewing plans catches costly mistakes early (e.g. editing secrets), but some practitioners get similar alignment through interactive Q&A and skip reading plans; value depends on task risk.

assertions.quote: We want to start a brand new session with Claude code ... We want it to have a fresh set of eyes

verdicts.note: Fresh context avoids accumulated noise, but compaction is useful when state is hard to reconstruct; it is a tradeoff, not a rule.

assertions.quote: Sub-agents is one of the best strategies for that

verdicts.note: Subagents return summaries rather than raw exploration; Anthropic reports gains from multi-agent research, at higher token cost.

assertions.quote: Just because you can fit a million tokens into a large language model does not mean that you should

verdicts.note: Long-context benchmarks (e.g. NoLiMa, context-rot studies) show degradation as context grows; the exact threshold is model-dependent.

assertions.quote: we want it to take care of as much validation as possible

verdicts.note: Agent benchmarks and practice consistently show verifiable feedback (tests, compilers) is the main driver of agent success.

assertions.quote: for any like serious production coding that I'm doing, I still am reviewing all of the code myself

verdicts.note: Given documented defect and security rates in AI code, human review before merge is standard practice (e.g. Amazon's two-person rule for AI-assisted changes); it's a sound norm.
The paper recommends careful review of AI code whatever the tool, along with static analysis, tests, security checks, and monitoring after merge.

assertions.quote: We can spend some time to fix ... the system that allowed the bug

verdicts.note: Encoding lessons in rules and workflows does reduce repeat mistakes, but rule files bloat and conflict if not pruned; gains are real but not automatically compounding.

assertions.quote: Our job as an engineer is to no longer write the code, but to do the higher leverage tasks like the planning and validating

verdicts.note: Surveys and studies (e.g. Faros, Google) report increased PR volume and review load with AI adoption.
The review finds developer work shifts from writing code toward specification, supervision and validation, with the unit of work moving to the acceptance decision.
